en: What the heck...!{wait}{clear}Sure, I know helping you set the world's turmoil right is important, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.{wait}{clear}But the country my brother's trying to protect matters to me too.{wait}{clear}This time I'm not listening to you. See ya!{wait}{clear}
I also think it is a very important duty. Don't worry about me. Go to the Empire.{wait}{clear}
Thanks, ＄＄＄＄＄＄. I'm relieved to hear you say that.{wait}{clear}Well, I've got to get ready.{wait}{clear}
Yes. Take care, Rudi.{wait}{clear}
Oh, you followed me here?{wait}{clear}
This country's cold... It doesn't suit me.{wait}{clear}
Straight to the talks, huh... I'm off to see the emperor.{wait}{clear}
Chancellor
Grand Duke Rudiere, envoy of the King of Legrance, welcome after your long journey.{wait}{clear}His Majesty has eagerly awaited the arrival of our friend from the south.{wait}{clear}
It is an honor to meet you, Your Majesty.{wait}{clear}
Endymion
We are pleased to meet you as well, Grand Duke.{wait}{clear}
Now, Grand Duke, forgive us after you've come all this way, but His Majesty is extremely busy.{wait}{clear}What is the King of Legrance's message? Kindly keep it brief.{wait}{clear}

Yes. As my country's representative, I wish to ask Your Majesty about the Empire's southward policy.{wait}{clear}The conflict your armies are waging in the south... I ask that you tell me where it is headed, and why.{wait}{clear}
Our current policy is to reclaim lands that rightfully belong to our Empire.{wait}{clear}We would have you understand that it is no threat to your young southern nation.{wait}{clear}

Precisely.{wait}{clear}The King of Legrance's concern is understandable, but our Empire and our Emperor have no such intentions whatsoever.{wait}{clear}The glory of our new Emperor rivals even that of the holy founding emperor, the Crimson Moon King.{wait}{clear}We understand the lords' unease, but we ask that you trust in his deep mercy.{wait}{clear}Rest easy, young Grand Duke.{wait}{clear}
.....{wait}{clear}Your Majesty, what are your thoughts on the people suffering from the war?{wait}{clear}
As a ruler, we naturally take them into account. But they do not outweigh the greater cause.{wait}{clear}
Well, our next audience is fast approaching.{wait}{clear}My apologies, but we must end things here.{wait}{clear}
Do be sure to tell the King of Legrance all you've heard. That his concerns are unfounded.{wait}{clear}
Ha ha, we're counting on you.{wait}{clear}And what will you do now, Grand Duke?{wait}{clear}
It's late today, so I intend to leave the capital early tomorrow morning.{wait}{clear}

I see. What a shame.{wait}{clear}Why, there's no need to hurry home. You could take your time touring this historic capital, said to be the most beautiful on the continent.{wait}{clear}I'm sure it would be most instructive for your young country. Ha ha ha...!{wait}{clear}
What's with that chancellor? What a creep...{wait}{clear}
...I'm going back to my room to sleep. I feel sick.{wait}{clear}
Tomorrow I'm leaving early and heading home.{wait}{clear}
I want out of this country as fast as I can.{wait}{clear}
All right... Please get some good rest in your room tonight...{wait}{clear}
Yeah... I will... I'll stay put in this room tonight...{wait}{clear}
Rudi, for now, please recover from your journey.{wait}{clear}
Good evening, Rudi.{wait}{clear}
That's strange... He said he would stay put in his room...{wait}{clear}Ah...! It seems he's outside. Let's go and see.{wait}{clear}
What... What's up?{wait}{clear}
Nothing, I was just a little worried about you...{wait}{clear}What about you, Rudi? What are you doing out here at this hour?{wait}{clear}
Oh, yeah... I just couldn't sleep.{wait}{clear}
I snuck out of my room and was looking at the view here...{wait}{clear}
Phew... Say what you will, that chancellor had a point...{wait}{clear}
Our country is young and has no history...{wait}{clear}
Maybe it's only natural they look down on me.{wait}{clear}
That isn't true{n}
Don't lose heart{n}
That isn't true. Your country is a fine one.{wait}{clear}Every country has its own circumstances. But none of them should be better or worse for it.{wait}{clear}
Our country's just getting started...{wait}{clear}
From here on, all we can do is what we're able to...{wait}{clear}
You don't need to lose heart over what others say.{wait}{clear}You're proud of Legrance, aren't you, Rudi? Believe in that feeling.{wait}{clear}
Yeah... You're right.{wait}{clear}
It's just getting started... our country.{wait}{clear}
All I can do is what I'm able to...{wait}{clear}
...Hm?{wait}{clear}
Isn't that the emperor over there?{wait}{clear}
Alone in the middle of the night... That's odd...{wait}{clear}
I'll go talk to him.{wait}{clear}
Your Majesty, is something the matter?{wait}{clear}
You are Legrance's...{wait}{clear}
Rudiere.{wait}{clear}
Rudiere... And what are you doing here?{wait}{clear}
I couldn't sleep, so I was looking out over the capital from here.{wait}{clear}
It's a beautiful city.{wait}{clear}
So many lights still burning, even this late at night.{wait}{clear}
Honestly, it makes me feel the gap between your power and my country's.{wait}{clear}
To me it is a sight I see every day... yet that is how it looks to you...{wait}{clear}
You seem rather tired.{wait}{clear}
Not really...{wait}{clear}
The chancellor and Serenis, who need me, take care of a great deal.{wait}{clear}
Do you come here often?{wait}{clear}
I often come when I have some free time...{wait}{clear}
Looking out at the world from here calms me.{wait}{clear}
Under each of those little lights, people are living out their own days...{wait}{clear}
When I imagine that... somehow... I can forget who I am now...{wait}{clear}
You're truly a kind person at heart, aren't you?{wait}{clear}
Why... would you say that?{wait}{clear}
Please forgive my rudeness.{wait}{clear}
It's just what I thought, listening to you just now.{wait}{clear}
Next time, please do visit our Legrance, Your Majesty.{wait}{clear}
It isn't as rich as the Empire, but the climate is mild and the food is plentiful and all delicious.{wait}{clear}
The people are a bit laid-back, but I think it's a very good country.{wait}{clear}
I'm sure you would have a wonderful time.{wait}{clear}
...That is the first time I have received such an invitation.{wait}{clear}
Don't stay shut away in here forever. Go out and feel the world.{wait}{clear}
I'm sure your thoughts and your heart would change in many ways.{wait}{clear}
Perhaps...{wait}{clear}
It would be good if I could do such a thing...{wait}{clear}
I'll be waiting.{wait}{clear}
Thank you, Grand Duke Rudiere.{wait}{clear}
Rudi is fine, Your Majesty.{wait}{clear}
...We have talked a long while. It would not do for Serenis to notice.{wait}{clear}
True. I should return to my room as well.{wait}{clear}
I hope we meet again... Rudi.{wait}{clear}
Yes, so do I, Your Majesty.{wait}{clear}
My name is Endymion... When no one else is around... you may use it.{wait}{clear}
All right, Endymion. Let's meet again.{wait}{clear}
Until we meet again, Rudi.{wait}{clear}
The emperor seemed like a different person from this afternoon...{wait}{clear}
It must be hard on him... being put on a pedestal so young.{wait}{clear}
But now I know exactly who's pulling this country's strings.{wait}{clear}
...The reincarnation of the legendary Crimson Moon King, huh. What nonsense...{wait}{clear}
Ah, ＄＄＄＄＄＄... I'm heading back home now.{wait}{clear}
Were you able to talk with the emperor about many things?{wait}{clear}
Yeah... sort of...{wait}{clear}Anyway, I need to report to my brother. Wait just a little longer, ＄＄＄＄＄＄. Once I'm done, I'll take your requests...{wait}{clear}
Yes, I understand. Take care on the road to Legrance...{wait}{clear}
Thanks...{wait}{clear}
You made it back safely, Rudi.{wait}{clear}
Yeah, it was no big deal.{wait}{clear}
So, how were the Empire and the emperor?{wait}{clear}

This is just my impression from talking with the emperor, but...{wait}{clear}I felt that him being the reincarnation of the legendary Crimson Moon King is a lie to make the people obey...{wait}{clear}I think it's the chancellor, not the emperor, who's running the Empire now.{wait}{clear}A man named Kreutzfeld. He seemed to be plotting something dark.{wait}{clear}He's got to be using the legend to get what he wants.{wait}{clear}
I see... So the Empire's threat is real.{wait}{clear}
I think so. There's no telling what that man will do.{wait}{clear}
But... as things stand, it will be hard to warn of an imperial invasion...{wait}{clear}
Why?{wait}{clear}

The great nobles... they have no interest in anything beyond our borders.{wait}{clear}They're desperate to protect their own country... no, their own interests and nothing else.{wait}{clear}It may sound like whining, but they're giving me some trouble these days...{wait}{clear}Still, complaining like this isn't my way.{wait}{clear}I'll manage somehow...{wait}{clear}Someday I'll be able to follow my own path as king, not as one tangled up in the nobles' schemes as I am now.{wait}{clear}When that day comes, Rudi, I'll need your help... I'm counting on you.{wait}{clear}
Yeah, I'll help. I promise.{wait}{clear}
Oh yes, Mother wanted to see you.{wait}{clear}She seems worried since she hasn't seen your face. Stop by if you have the time.{wait}{clear}
Got it.{wait}{clear}
You seem tired.{wait}{clear}
Well, yeah. I was rushing around doing stuff I'm not used to.{wait}{clear}
Take my requests again...{n}
Are you worried?{n}
Will you take my requests again?{wait}{clear}
Yeah, don't worry. Like I promised, I'll get back to it.{wait}{clear}
Just let me rest today, at least.{wait}{clear}
You sure are a slave driver... A promise is a promise. I'll keep it.{wait}{clear}Just let me rest today, at least.{wait}{clear}
Are you worried?{wait}{clear}
About what? My brother?{wait}{clear}
...It's not that I'm worried. It's just unusual.{wait}{clear}That's the first time I've heard him say something so weak.{wait}{clear}
He's probably just worn out from being so busy. I'm sure my brother will pull through...{wait}{clear}
You're in a good mood.{wait}{clear}
Whoa, ＄＄＄＄＄＄. Don't tell me you were watching?{wait}{clear}
I was watching{n}
